title: Tiny Diffusion Transformer (DiT)
description: A 32×32 Diffusion Transformer: 4×4 patchifying convolution stem, 2 DiT blocks pairing adaptive LayerNorm-Zero (AdaLN-Zero) conditioning modulation with QK-normalized self-attention and SwiGLU feed-forward networks, followed by an AdaLN-Zero final modulation, 1×1 unpatchify projection, and 4× pixel_shuffle.
reference: Architecture follows Peebles & Xie 2023, "Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers" (DiT, ICCV 2023, arXiv:2212.09748); parameter count checked against plain PyTorch: patch_stem 128·3·4·4+128 = 6,272, pos_emb 64·128 = 8,192, 2 DiT blocks each (attn_adaln 128·384+384 = 49,536, attn 4·(128·128+128)+64 = 66,112, ffn_adaln 128·384+384 = 49,536, SwiGLU 3·(128·384) = 147,456; block total 312,640) = 625,280, final_adaln 49,536, unpatchify 48·128·1·1+48 = 6,192, pixel_shuffle 0; total 6,272 + 8,192 + 625,280 + 49,536 + 6,192 = 695,472.
